tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC), a Government of Karnataka undertaking, invites sealed tenders from eligible, experienced, and financially sound firms / companies / agencies for the grant of exclusive rights to install, operate, maintain, and manage an IN-BUS AUDIO ADVERTISEMENT SYSTEM 300 Bus fleet operated in the Bengaluru Metropolitan Region.
EMD payments through e-payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderer shall refer the Tender Document for all the Terms and Conditions and agree to abide by them.
Highest offer received in the tender shall be criteria for selection of bidder (INCLUDING GST ONLY).
The period of License is for 36 months
Refer Tender document for all criteria other Terms & conditions
Minimum 300 buses in Phase I- scaling to fleet NON-AC
